description: Maps each stubble card (by index) to its nearest long hair card. Every stubble card index 0..2864 has exactly one entry, guaranteeing full coverage - each long hair card may own multiple entries (its full nearby cluster), unlike the old one-entry-per-long-card version. When a long hair card is cut down to nothing, reveal ALL stubble cards whose long_card_name matches it, within the stubble mesh (HairCards_InductionCut / HairCards_ButchCut / HairCards_CrewCut - they share the same card indexing).
